verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API described as the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI, which is a direct first-party UI-parity claim. The official CLI and MCP server add further programmatic and AI-client access to gates, experiments and configs. missing for 10: endpoint-level evidence that every UI area (analytics, access management, Warehouse Native) is covered, independent or hands-on confirmation of parity, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
